source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = counts.most_common(2)[1][0]
    cells = [(r, c, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row)
             if v != background and v != marker]
    r0 = min(r for r, c, v in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c, v in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c, v in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c, v in cells)
    cr, cc = (r0 + r1) // 2, (c0 + c1) // 2
    shape = [(r - cr, c - cc, v) for r, c, v in cells]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, v in enumerate(row):
            if v == marker:
                for dr, dc, color in shape:
                    rr, cc2 = r + dr, c + dc
                    if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc2 < w:
                        out[rr][cc2] = color
    return out
'''
